title: What the Canadian federal government is doing — daily intelligence sheet
subtitle: Stated actions, active files, and mapped future plans. Primary sources preferred. Inferences labeled.
one_line: Defence spending ladder + Arctic build-out dominate the near horizon; Griffon GLLE pause sits inside a four-point procurement distortion cluster; industrial strategy aims to convert announcements into domestic contracts.

happening_now.headline: NATO 2026 partnerships: missiles, Arctic SATCOM, spend ladder
happening_now.body: PM release (8 Jul 2026): path language toward 5% GDP defence/security by 2035; ~$800M Kongsberg Joint Strike Missiles; Telesat Lightspeed Arctic military SATCOM agreement-in-principle; prior Arctic OTHR / icebreaker / long-range missile packages cited as context.

happening_now.headline: CH-146 Griffon GLLE ~$800M paused for reassessment
happening_now.body: DND: work paused for cost, schedule, complexity, and replacement-fleet planning. Official program still shows ≤$90M definition / ≤$800M implementation, FOC 2027, fleet 85. CBC 27 Jun 2026 freezes public pause narrative.

happening_now.headline: Multi-decade Arctic defence infrastructure wave
happening_now.body: Reported packages: ~$40B+ northern defend/build framing; OTHR with Australia (~$4.67B/5y class); polar icebreakers; hubs and airfields. Sovereignty narrative: less reliance on others for northern coverage.

happening_now.headline: Defence Investment Agency + Industrial Strategy in motion
happening_now.body: Departmental Plan 2026–27: DIA + Defence Industrial Strategy to speed procurement, grow domestic manufacturing, modernize infrastructure. Industry messaging: jobs + Canadian content share.

happening_now.headline: CBC 5GW information-vector dossier opened
happening_now.body: NEW FILE: OSINT analysis of CBC/Radio-Canada as taxpayer-funded cognitive-domain asset — ~$1.38B parliamentary appropriation class, GIC appointments, $595M private-news subsidy stack, tax-dollar→consent→policy-harm chain under Trudeau-era policy. FACT vs INFERENCE labeled. Page cbc-5gw-media-vector.html + data/cbc_5gw_analysis.json.

happening_now.headline: TENET5 record continues primary-source mapping
happening_now.body: Site maintains Article II / procurement / capture dossiers with primary cites. Daily sheet is the public tail: what government is doing + what the multi-year map looks like.
